summary: Endless browser space-runner with Three.js bloom and a Web Audio engine synthesized live - no sound files, no build step. Near-miss bonuses and a daily seeded run everyone plays the same.
key_features: Endless browser space-runner with real Three.js bloom post-processing and hand-written particles
Audio engine synthesized live in Web Audio - not one sound file in the repository
Skim an obstacle without touching it and take the near-miss bonus
A daily run seeded from the UTC date deals every player the same obstacles; 0.8 MB first load, no build step
Every test runs with the page sealed to its own origin, so a reintroduced CDN import breaks CI instead of passing it

social.headline: 0.8 MB, no build step, real bloom - and every sound synthesized on the fly.

provenance.rule: mechanical fields read from the repository and the GitHub API; editorial fields hand-written and reviewed; no field is generated from a guess
